oru_intro.speaker: Oru
oru_intro.text: The district is cut off. Restore both ends of the Lantern Loom so everyone can come home.

oru_intro.speaker: Oru
oru_intro.text: Follow the brass signs through the Atrium. At Spindle Steps, each courier takes a different anchor.

oru_intro.speaker: Tavi
oru_intro.text: I can clear a path. Keep your thread close.

oru_intro.speaker: Neri
oru_intro.text: And I can reach what you cannot. We take both ends.

oru_return.speaker: Oru
oru_return.text: Different roads. Same promise. Welcome home.

bridge_spindle_complete.speaker: Tavi
bridge_spindle_complete.text: I thought you were holding the other end.

bridge_spindle_complete.speaker: Neri
bridge_spindle_complete.text: I was. You finally stopped pulling.

boss_defeated.speaker: Tavi
boss_defeated.text: It was keeping the road safe.
Threadstep is yours. Return to the Atrium and cross the causeway.

ending.text: The Lantern Loom is lit. The stranded district has a road home.

charm_found.text: A lantern charm, left for the next traveller. Both lanterns carry its light.

causeway_restored.speaker: Neri
causeway_restored.text: Look. The far lanterns are answering.

warden_warning.text: Keep a thread for the one behind you.
